title: 3.6 Pentastar (2018-2025): misfire, rough idle, valvetrain tick from worn intake cam lobes and rocker arms
summary: Stellantis TSB 09-011-25: on 3.6L V6 engines (sales codes ERC, ERG) built through late 2024, misfire codes P0301-P0306, rough idle or valvetrain noise can come from worn intake high-lift cam lobes and rocker-arm sliders, typically at 10,000-60,000 miles. Repair with the intake cam/rocker kit, not a long block.

specs.name: Engines
specs.value: 3.6L V6 24V VVT Upg I w/ESS (sales code ERC) or eTorque Upg I (sales code ERG)

specs.name: Kit contents
specs.value: Intake camshaft, rocker arms, sealer and gaskets

steps.text: Symptoms: MIL with one or more of P0301-P0306, rough idle, and/or valvetrain noise.
Narrow it to a bank with a stethoscope or with which cylinder is setting the misfire code.
Pull the valve cover on that bank and look at the intake high-lift cam lobes and the rocker-arm high-lift sliders for wear.
If the wear is confirmed, repair with the intake cam/rocker kit for that side (68661147 right, 68661146 left) instead of replacing the engine or long block.
Ask the parts department to confirm the correct kit for the vehicle; the STAR case lists 68661147AA "or equivalent" while the later TSB lists 68661147AB.

Before releasing the vehicle, confirm it has the latest calibration for oil pump operation mode (high-pressure mode at engine start-up). RU, VF, WL and WD already have it from 2025 model year on; JL and JT got it as a 2024 running change (08/15/24 and 08/19/24); DT from 2025 model year. 2024 vehicles with a service release available should get that update.

body:
TSB 09-011-25 is information only: it is not an authorization for repair, and the build-date cutoffs above decide whether it applies. Covered vehicles: 2019-2025 Ram 1500 (DT), 2018-2025 Wrangler (JL), 2020-2025 Gladiator (JT), 2018-2025 Pacifica (RU), 2018-2025 Durango (WD), 2018-2022 Grand Cherokee (WK), 2021-2025 Grand Cherokee / Grand Cherokee L (WL) and 2022-2025 ProMaster (VF).

The Ram 1500 range here does not tell the DT apart from the 2019+ Ram 1500 Classic (DS), which the bulletin does not list. Check the body code before applying it.

Source 3 is an image-only PDF, so the citation checker can't read it; its step was read from the page.
